scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,APP -c magenta,green "npm run dev -w @platinum/server" "npm run web -w @platinum/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @platinum/server && npm run export:web -w @platinum/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @platinum/server && npm run typecheck -w @platinum/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @platinum/server && npm run test -w @platinum/client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:installer-safety -w @platinum/desktop
